Workday HCM pricing in 2026

Workday publishes no price on its own site, but it does publish one for UK public-sector buyers: its G-Cloud 15 pricing document prices the Core HCM + Global Payroll Connect bundle at £163.22 per employee per year for 750 to 1,500 employees, falling by headcount band to £59.35 above 50,000, excluding VAT, with minimum deal values. Commercial deals are quoted, and the G-Cloud price list covers the subscription only, with no implementation price, so a Workday cost is two quotes, not one. Get the subscription priced per module with headcount bands, the implementation as a fixed fee with a written scope, and the renewal cap in writing.

How the price is built

Implementation is not in the G-Cloud subscription prices. Get it priced before comparing Workday with a vendor that sells setup inside its subscription.

What to get priced in writing

  • The per-employee rate for each module you take, as separate lines
  • Any monthly base or platform fee, stated separately from the per-employee rate
  • Whether any charge is per payroll run rather than per month, and the rate
  • The one-time implementation fee and what it covers
  • The contract term, any seat minimum, and the annual renewal increase cap in writing

For scale, the vendors that do publish an HRIS seat rate list from $3 to $29 per employee per month (every published rate). Enter your Workday HCM quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to set it against them over 3 years.

Does Workday publish its prices?

Not on workday.com. The one public price list is its G-Cloud 15 listing for UK public-sector buyers, which prices bundles per employee per year by headcount band: Core HCM + Global Payroll Connect at £163.22 for 750 to 1,500 employees down to £59.35 above 50,000 (pricing document dated 29 January 2026, excluding VAT, minimum deal values apply). Commercial buyers get a quote.

What does a Workday cost include?

Two contracts: the subscription (Core HCM plus modules such as Payroll, Recruiting, Learning and Compensation) and the implementation, which the G-Cloud price list does not cover. Ask whether Workday or a partner firm implements, and price both before comparing Workday with a vendor that includes setup in its subscription.

What should the subscription quote show?

The per-employee rate for each module, how the rate changes as headcount grows (the G-Cloud price list falls at every band), the term, the annual renewal cap and the price of adding employees mid-term.

When does Workday make sense over UKG Pro?

Workday is usually chosen for global, multi-country HR and its finance integration; UKG Pro for workforce management such as scheduling and time. Neither publishes a commercial price, so the cost comparison needs both quotes at your headcount.
